events.ai_basis: The models suggested an argument leading to a bound of the form h(E) ≪ N(log log N)^2, which was subsequently verified and reconstructed by the author. That motivated further work by the author, leading to the stronger results proved in this paper.

why: Szpiro's statement is a single polynomial inequality for all E/Q, so only a full proof is whole. Pasten 2609.17390 improves the unconditional bound on the statement's own quantity log|Δ| in terms of the conductor (N log N to N log log N): bound, not whole, unreviewed (the Pith AI referee is not review). Its AI statement says the models supplied an argument giving an intermediate bound that the author reconstructed and built on, which is mathematics in the line of the result: assisted rather than generated (the author proved the stronger final theorems) and not none (more than a strategy hint). Pasten 2608.23559 bounds the Faltings height for integral j, a stronger conjecture on a class where the statement was already proved (Pesenti–Szpiro), so variant; its AI was 'initial exploratory directions', which would be none in any case. Joshi IV claims abc and hence the statement: whole, unreviewed, doubtful given the specific Cor. 3.12 dispute, not knocked_down because the objection is contested and second-hand. Zenodo abc claims are not_credible. Pasten 2023 is a pre-snapshot case (published in CUBO, so digested). Chan's almost-all result and number-field/local/geometric analogues are variants; Cuevas–Pasten bounds the same quantity in families, read as bound.
doubts: Close calls: whether the 2609.17390 AI contribution is assisted or none (the AI argument gave a weaker bound superseded by the author's; I judged it part of the mathematics the result grew from), and whether Cuevas–Pasten is bound or variant. The AI quote was read through a model-mediated summary, not verbatim. Mestre–Oesterlé and Pesenti–Szpiro are undated in the record (null after_snapshot), though clearly old. Verification 'digested' for old journal papers rests on the record's publication venues.
